utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. Case number IT-01-47-T, the Prosecutor versus Enver Hadzihasanovic and Amir Kubura.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we have the appearances for the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good afternoon, Your Honours, Counsel, and everyone in and around the courtroom. For the Prosecution, Stefan Waespi, Matthias Neuner, and Daryl Mundis, assisted by Mr. Andres Vatter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we have the appearances for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Mr. President. Good afternoon, Your Honours. On behalf of General Enver Hadzihasanovic, Edina Residovic, lead counsel, and Stephane Bourgon, co-counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. And the other Defence team, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. On behalf of Mr. Kubura, Rodney Dixon, Fahrudin Ibrisimovic, and Nermin Mulalic, legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On this day, the 9th of March, 2005, I bid good afternoon to all those present: The representatives of the Prosecution, the Defence counsel, the accused, and all the personnel of this courtroom. If there is nothing in particular to address, we can go into closed session, and I shall ask the registrar to pull down the blinds and for us to go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We are in open session, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In open session, today's hearing will be over in a couple of minutes. I said last time that due to a Plenary, which has to be held on Friday, that we will have to begin our hearing at quarter past 3.00. However, the Plenary Session has been called off, which means that we can begin at 2.15. So I wanted to let you know this so that you can make all the necessary arrangements in preparation of the witness for Friday. If there are no other matters to address, I will adjourn the hearing and ask you to come back tomorrow, as I have said, at 2.15 tomorrow. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 10th day of March, 2005, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.57 p.m.,
